official-robust.tsv: 55 UTF-8 inputs and pinned robust normalizer outputs, base64 columns
official-normalization.tsv: The same inputs through robust_pre -> WeTextProcessing 1.2.0 -> robust_post; base64 input/output columns, language selected with the pinned Yuewen fallback
official-pcg64.txt: 10,000 IEEE-754 double bit patterns from NumPy 1.26.4 default_rng(1234).random(), one lowercase hex value per line
tokenizer.model: Unmodified MOSS-TTS-Nano-100M-ONNX tokenizer used to test real 75-token boundaries; test-only, not packaged in APK
normalizerGraphs: main/assets/tts/normalizer/manifest.json records exact WeText graph options and SHA-256 hashes
longformTest: OfficialModelParityTest is opt-in via ttsModelRoot, ttsReferenceRoot and ttsParityOutput; it uses external weights and official reference codes/PCM, never an emulator
